- Not stacked.  
- Text labels are placed directly on or near bars.

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Cause of death | Categorical/nominal | One horizontal bar per category; direct text labels on bars |
| Mortality rate gap between Black and white people (deaths per 100k) | Quantitative | Bar length and horizontal position relative to the zero line (x-axis) |

| Overall death rate for selected causes (e.g., “149 per 100k”, “21 per 100k”) | Quantitative | Text annotations with leader lines |
| Population group comparison (Black vs white) | Categorical/nominal | Referenced in title and axis annotations; encoded through signed direction of bars rather than separate marks |
| Year (2018) | Temporal | Text note/caption only |

1. **Chart type**: Diverging horizontal bar chart.

2. **Layout techniques**:  
- Uses a **single panel** (no faceting or small multiples).  
- Bars **diverge from a central zero line** to show direction of the gap.  
- Not stacked.  
- Text labels are placed directly on or near bars.

3. **Data variables**:

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Cause of death | Categorical/nominal | One horizontal bar per category; direct text labels on bars |
| Mortality rate gap between Black and white people (deaths per 100k) | Quantitative | Bar length and horizontal position relative to the zero line (x-axis) |
| Direction of disparity (higher Black death rate vs higher white death rate) | Categorical/nominal | Side of zero on the x-axis (right vs left), reinforced by annotations |
| Rank / relative prominence of cause (e.g., “Second-largest cause,” “Seventh-largest cause”) | Ordinal | Text annotations with leader lines |
| Overall death rate for selected causes (e.g., “149 per 100k”, “21 per 100k”) | Quantitative | Text annotations with leader lines |
| Population group comparison (Black vs white) | Categorical/nominal | Referenced in title and axis annotations; encoded through signed direction of bars rather than separate marks |
| Year (2018) | Temporal | Text note/caption only |
